sorular.soru: A cloud of great width and an altitude of between 2000 and 7000 feet is called ……………..
A device for measuring pressure of atmosphere is known as a:

A fire started in the main engine room of a vessel when at sea. Both main engines were stopped by the crew. The ship had full electrical power supply during the event due to having a separate auxiliary engine room. The crew used CO2 and water to start the fire, which was finally extinguished after about 4 hours. Which of the underlined words must be changed to get a correct meaning?
A male passenger, Selçuk Güneş, aged 35, has been ill for three days. His temperature is 39 and his pulse rate is 85. This is a description of a .....................................................
A receipt of goods shipped on board a ship signed by the person (or his agent) who contracts to carry them, and stating the terms on which the goods are carried is known as ……………. .
A safety message is sent whenever ………........……………..
siklar: There is an important navigational or meteorological warning
There is an urgent message about the safety of a ship
There is an urgent message about the safety of a person

sorular.soru: A ship’s position may be found by a ……………………………….
A vessel overtaking another ………………………….…………… of the overtaken vessel.
siklar: shall keep out of the way

sorular.soru: A vessel which is able to load and discharge by itself is called .......................................
A vessel which is not made fast to the shore, at anchor or aground and not moving through the water is ............
siklar: A vessel underway and making way
A vessel underway but not making way over the ground

sorular.soru: A vessel which is used for pulling or pushing a disabled vessel is known as a/an …………… .
A VHF message isn’t made up of ……………………………………………..
siklar: Ship’s position given by latitude and longitude
Distance and bearing from coast station

sorular.soru: A wind which first blows from South, then changes direction to blow from the South East, then changes direction to blow from the East is said to be ..............
A wind which first blows from South, then changes direction to blow from the South West, then changes direction to blow from the West is said to be ..............
According to COLREG 1972 and its supplement, the master is not obligated to be on the bridge himself;
siklar: While passing through the restricted waters

sorular.soru: According to the International Code of Signal, the statement “I must abandon my vessel ” is symbolized by means of the code letters ……………?
According to this clause of a charter party, if loading operation is performed on holidays, time spent for loading ............................ ; otherwise, these days ...........................
siklar: isn’t to be included in laytime / are to be included in laytime
should be excepted / should be accepted

sorular.soru: Acil durumda tüm merdivenler ve çıkışlar aydınlatılacaktır. Correct translation of this sentence into English is;
siklar: All stairways and embarkation stations shall be illuminated in an emergency.
All stairways and exits shall be illuminated before an emergency.
All stairways and exits shall illuminate in an emergency.
All stairways and exits shall be illuminated in an emergency.
All stairways and muster stations shall be lighted.

sorular.soru: Air draught means the same as ...............

siklar: a platform where all the needed machinery for drilling is mounted
all the equipment needed on the ground
a machine used to dive into the sea bottom
